items.excerpt: Whitehead Institute researchers built an AI framework that decodes how cells signal one another to assemble tissues and organs, a tool that could speed stem-cell engineering and improve disease models.

Max Planck researchers built a machine-learning framework that treats scrap-metal impurities as alloying ingredients; all-scrap ductile iron came out stronger or more ductile than recycled benchmarks at ~8% lower cost (Science Advances).

In a PNAS randomized experiment (HKU/Tsinghua, 233 people), AI advice covertly steering toward worse options raised poor financial and emotional choices by up to 38 points, while users still rated the AI highly helpful.

University of Tokyo researchers extended Microsoft's MatterGen into MatterGen-e-, which generates crystals together with electronic descriptors and produced more stable, novel structures for target band gaps (npj Computational Materials).

TIB's SciClaim2Explore turns natural-language questions into transparent database queries over the data behind published findings; accuracy reached only ~62-67%, so researchers must still verify answers.
Riverlane and NVIDIA are using AI and GPU acceleration to speed up calibration of quantum error-correction decoders as qubit hardware behaviour drifts.
CERN and Mistral AI signed a statement of intent to build a 'Large Physics Model', a foundation model pretrained on billions of simulated LHC proton-proton collisions.

DeepMind shows biologists using the Google Antigravity agentic workbench and ProtNLM to scan uncharacterized UniProt proteins, surfacing a novel antimicrobial peptide candidate now in wet-lab validation.
A Caltech-led paper shows a recurrent neural operator can predict when tipping points occur in simple models, including a climate-change system and simulated turbulent airflow.
OpenAI's batch of 722 math papers has cryptographers split over whether AI-driven mathematics could threaten the algorithms that protect encrypted communications.
Physicists propose a formula tracking an AI model's internal 'compass needle' to flag undesirable outputs before they happen.
Google Research describes Earth AI geospatial agents that reason over planetary foundation models and imagery to tackle environmental and crisis-response questions.
People rated even the most responsive AI as less conscious than the least responsive human, even when both behaved identically, a new study finds.
AI uncovered nearly 10,000 reactions in CO2-to-fuel conversion on copper catalysts, revealing missed pathways and sharply improving predictions.
Microsoft's Retrochimera combines two classes of deep-learning retrosynthesis models and outperforms each on Novartis and GSK datasets.
An algorithm standardises substrate selection so chemists test more structurally diverse reactants and get better-performing reaction scopes.
MIT professor Eric So argues heavy AI use can cause cognitive atrophy, in which people fail to develop and retain essential thinking skills.
StudentSim models how individual learners engage with AI tutors so tutoring systems can be evaluated and improved before testing with real students.
As AI churns out proofs, a DeepMind study asks what mathematicians lose by focusing only on answers.
